verdict.rationale: Storing passkeys and signing in with them is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only one-time verification codes (TOTP/HOTP generation, sync, transfer and management). Nothing in the pack shows the app storing passkeys or using them to sign into sites or apps.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes
